summary: Scale Computing provides hyperconverged edge-computing infrastructure (Scale Computing Platform) marketed specifically for quick-service restaurant and hospitality IT, positioned to run in-store applications such as POS, inventory, loyalty, and kitchen display systems on a centrally managed, small-form-factor edge platform.

Royal Farms deployed the Scale Computing Platform edge-computing solution across 300+ convenience/fuel retail locations to modernize in-store IT and support always-available customer experience. (Scope note: Royal Farms is a convenience/fuel retailer, not a traditional restaurant chain, though it operates significant foodservice offerings; case study is vendor-published.)
